# Upstream specification sources

`plugin.schema.json` is the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema published by
[agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec](https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec),
reviewed at `44a0ff84bfdfebccfc649dce9aea9ccc45cbfbf9`. Software material, including
schemas, is provided under Apache-2.0; the accompanying license is retained here.

`specifications.json` records source URLs, reviewed hashes, stable plugin version and
the official skills-ref revision. The remaining upstream material is not copied.
Agent Plugins 1.1.0 is a working draft, not the current published specification.
Refresh pins only after reviewing normative/schema/validator changes and regressions.
